work.title: Twin Tongues, Twin Targets
work.description: Layered fragments of printed ephemera, engineering schematics, and cut paper cover a black ground, anchored by horizontal warplane line drawings overlaid with vertical red-and-yellow bands. Four gold compact discs, two archery targets, mirrored Rolling Stones tongue-and-lip logos, an Arsenal badge, and an American football distribute across the composition alongside photographic sports imagery and metallic foil.
work.composition: wide horizontal panorama with twin tongue anchors
